contexts.text: The princes of Pharaoh = primary precepts. Explained.
Primary precepts which are of charity. Signified.
The primary things of truth, which are precepts. Signified.
By (these things) are signified the primary things of faith.
The primary thing of representative worship...
The primary of the Rational is truth...
The love of self is the primary thing which destroys order...
The primary thing from the truths of the Church with the Ancients. Signified.
Those who are primary in Heaven...
For what is primary is also general, because it reigns in the rest; for particulars relate to primaries as to generals...
That they have what is primary in the natural mind. Signified, Explained.
The son of a king = what is primary. Explained.
The elders of Israel = the primary things of wisdom and intelligence which accord with good and with truth; thus primary truths. AC 8585. AC 8681. AC 8773.
They who are in good which is not as yet formed through truths, are first formed by the Lord through primary truths; that is, through general truths... primary truths are, that God is one, etc.
The primary things through which is the conjunction of the Lord with the human race through the Word. Signified, Explained.
If they do these primary things which are of eternal Truth. Signified, Explained. AC 10638:2.
Information concerning the primary truths which are to be remembered and done. Signified. AC 10699. AC 10728.
The primary robe () = general and primary truths.
